Hi all!
I am very happy to announce that the Bleak Sword OST is now available for purchase on Steam with a 10% launch discount, and an additional 15% off added to all owners of the game.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/33582/Bleak_Sword_DX__Soundtrack/

-Luis

notes.title: Bleak Sword DX: Introducing the Arena and Boss Rush
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43606346/09aa973aeb927cc7b809be96d37e04d235c8e753.png[/img]

Hi everyone! Bleak Sword DX is just around the corner. It's coming out on June 8 at 9 AM Pacific, and I'm beyond excited to see everyone jump in. I wanted to share more about what I've added to the game for PC.

A few days ago, I covered the DX Campaign and the Randomizer mode, which will make for the ultimate Bleak Sword experience. Today, I want to focus on new features that will provide you with virtually endless replayability - The Boss Rush and Arena game modes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43606346/9a31ca7d5be266d571137a116adc1ae0318e8423.gif[/img]

Personally, I feel that boss fights are the most exciting encounters in the game. I've wanted to add Boss Rush since the original launch.  

In this new mode, you'll fight all 12 bosses in a row. To make things even tougher, you can't level up or use any items from the standard campaign. With just one health bar to survive all 12 encounter, it's the ultimate challenge. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43606346/72fac202e9da6ee280d39c2a3e8ed5c916b2a153.gif[/img]

The next new addition is Arena Mode. My original idea for Bleak Sword was an endless gauntlet of increasingly difficult levels. Ultimately, I focused on a campaign-based experience but now, the Arena Mode returns to the game's roots. 

Here, you'll recover a bit of health after each wave as there are no items to help your run. This mode emphasizes crowd control and I suggest you take out weaker targets before focusing on bigger threats to stay as healthy as you can. 

Once again, I really can't wait to bring the best version of Bleak Sword to all of you later this week!

Much love.
-Luis

notes.title: Introducing the DX Campaign and Randomzier
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43606346/7cfb8f0578a9121aced0f8050808e3107d9a538e.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone! As I prepare the final touches to launch Bleak Sword DX in a week on June 8, I wanted to share some of the new campaign modes that will mix up your diorama pixel combat gameplay.

The new [b]DX Campaign[/b] is something I've wanted to add ever since I started planning for the PC version of the game. It includes many new levels and new enemy AI that will span 12 challenging chapters. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43606346/64e0932a0813bba013944e2c006ba36d7d6542bd.gif[/img]

For extra replayability, I've also added [b]Randomizer[/b] mode which will mix bosses, levels, and gear from any part of the game for some chaotic runs. 

And of course, the campaign from the original Bleak Sword is still there. This new version contains everything in the original game, all DLC and updates, plus new modes, new features, and a revamped control scheme for PC players. 

I can't wait to see everyone enjoy Bleak Sword the way it's meant to be played when it launches on June 8.

Much love.
-Luis
